title: Accept sequential signer revisions in `check-design-patterns` and `check-prds`
summary: Under a `current-revision` approval rule, the design and product checkers now accept the revision each sequential signer captured with the earlier approvals already present, as `check-seal` does, so a quorum-2 seal that `check-seal` ratifies no longer fails as `ACTIVE_RECIPE_UNSEALED` or `PRD_UNSEALED`.
